title: Equipment monitoring and utilization
functions: Machine and 3D printer statuses (running/stopped/waiting)
Equipment task queue and linkage to orders
Day/week plan without a heavy MES
Downtime and bottlenecks: what is stopped and why
Quick answer via AI chat: “what is this printer/machine doing?”

title: Inventory management
functions: Stock levels of materials, tools, and spare parts
Minimum stock levels and “what’s urgent” reminders
Reserves for current orders
List of critical items for specific equipment
Draft replenishment requests (with owner approval)

title: Product quality control
functions: Checklists for key operations without bureaucracy
Recording defects/rework linked to the order and equipment
Statistics on causes and recurrence (including Pareto)
Linking quality to materials, settings, and people
Photos/videos for problematic cases

title: Recording and analyzing failures
functions: Equipment event log: what happened and when
Classification of causes (no material, print error, breakdown, etc.)
Notifications about critical incidents and long downtimes
Detecting repeated errors and linking them to order deadlines
Integration with maintenance and spare parts inventory

title: Product delivery to customers
functions: Shipment list: what to send today/this week
Delivery statuses (ready/in transit/delivered)
Customer notifications upon shipment
Tracking delivery services where it truly saves time
Quick overview of “where delays happen most often”
